text_simplified: Tarbiyah (upbringing) of children is a tremendous responsibility, and its most important foundation is planting the worship of Allah alone in their hearts from a young age. Parents must exert effort and spend wealth in raising their children with sound Islamic tarbiyah, for it is the greatest charity and reward. Likewise, the tarbiyah of daughters requires special care and continuous nurturing.

review_defects.why: Tarbiyah is an ordinary Arabic word meaning upbringing or education, not a technical Islamic term requiring transliteration. Using it makes the English stiff and less natural, especially in the title where it is not glossed.
